generatorSummary: Listing generator dry run is ready but blocked by missing validated inputs. The service may generate structure and readiness output only. It must not generate final listing content until Portex product facts, commercial readiness, image QA, shipping/returns and risk/compliance are approved. It must use market intelligence without copying competitor content. It must not call eBay, OpenAI, Supabase or external APIs. It must not create drafts or publish.

architecturePolicy.productsRule: Products decide what the product is.
architecturePolicy.listingRule: Listing decides how the product sells on eBay.
architecturePolicy.benchmarkRule: Benchmark decides what is working in the market.
architecturePolicy.gatesRule: Gates decide whether the listing can advance.
architecturePolicy.operatingPrinciple: Benchmark can suggest, Listing can adapt, Products must confirm, Gates must approve.
architecturePolicy.productSourceOfTruth: Portex product facts and IMNOVA Products module are the source of truth for technical claims.
architecturePolicy.listingRole: The listing generator creates original eBay selling content only from confirmed facts and allowed market intelligence.

benchmarkKeywordPolicy.coreRule: Use market intelligence, do not copy competitor content.

keywordClasses.label: Core keywords
keywordClasses.rule: Use when generic, relevant, truthful and supported by confirmed product facts.

keywordClasses.label: Secondary keywords
keywordClasses.rule: Use when relevant and not misleading.

keywordClasses.label: Risk keywords
keywordClasses.rule: Require human risk review before use.

keywordClasses.label: Blocked keywords
keywordClasses.rule: Do not use competitor brands, unsupported claims or exact copied text.

requiredHumanActions: Validate traffic keywords as generic, relevant and true.
Confirm pricing, fees, margin and shipping.
Keep eBay draft creation blocked until all gates are approved.
